-- 过滤头顶文字气泡
AddComponentPostInit("talker", function(Talker)
	local OldSay = Talker.Say
	Talker.Say = function(self, script, time, noanim, force, nobroadcast, colour, text_filter_context,
						  original_author_netid, onfinishedlinesfn, sgparam)
		-- 只过滤客户端本地的头顶气泡（nobroadcast=true 表示已在本地，不会再次广播）
		if nobroadcast and ThePlayer then
			local canHear = false
			if self.inst.userid and self.inst.prefab and (self.inst.prefab ~= "") then
				if self.inst.prefab == "ningen" then
					canHear = ThePlayer and (ThePlayer.prefab == "ningen")
				else
					canHear = (not ThePlayer) or (ThePlayer.prefab ~= "ningen")
				end
			else
				canHear = true

snippets.AddPrefabPostInit:ningen:
-- 宁恩生成后执行，从本地读取数据进行绑定。
	AddPrefabPostInit("ningen", function(inst)
		if TheWorld.ismastersim then return end -- 本地环境启动！
		if TUNING.ningen_kuacundhj then
			inst:DoTaskInTime(0.1, function()
				-- 游戏框架内置功能：读取文件数据，传入文件数据和读取后要执行的函数，函数第一个参数为读取成功与否，第二个参数为读取的数据。
				TheSim:GetPersistentString("xrkiller_whaledata", function(istrue, xrkiller_whaledata)
					if istrue then
						-- 发送绑定虎鲸的RPC，隐参数为发送者，显参数为虎鲸数据。
						SendModRPCToServer(MOD_RPC["xr_kuacund"]["killwewhale"], xrkiller_whaledata)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end)
snippets.AddPrefabPostInit:world:
if not TUNING.ningen_kuacundhj then
		AddPrefabPostInit("world", function(world)
			if not TheWorld.ismastersim then return end
			world:AddComponent("worldkillerwhalefriend")
			world.components.worldkillerwhalefriend.allwhaledata = {}
			world:ListenForEvent("ms_newplayerspawned", function(world, inst)
				if not inst then return end
				if inst:HasTag("ningen") then
					if world.components.worldkillerwhalefriend.allwhaledata[inst.userid] and inst.components.killer_whalefriend then
						inst.components.killer_whalefriend:OnLoad(world.components.worldkillerwhalefriend.allwhaledata
							[inst.userid])
					end
				end
				world.components.worldkillerwhalefriend.allwhaledata[inst.userid] = nil
			end)
		end)

AddPrefabPostInit("archive_lockbox", function(inst)
		inst:ListenForEvent("onteach", function(inst)
			local pos = inst:GetPosition()
			inst:DoTaskInTime(174 / 30, function()
				if (inst.product_orchestrina == "turf_vault") or (inst.product_orchestrina == "vaultrelic") then
					local x, y, z = inst.Transform:GetWorldPosition()
					local players = FindPlayersInRange(x, y, z, 20, true)
					for i, player in ipairs(players) do
						if not player.components.builder:KnowsRecipe("xr_vault_orb") then
							local loot = SpawnPrefab("xr_vault_orb_blueprint")
							player.components.inventory:GiveItem(loot, nil, pos)
						end
					end
				end
			end)

snippets.AddComponentPostInit:skinner:
--人物皮肤的init_fn 和 clear_fn
    AddComponentPostInit("skinner",function(self)
        local oldfn = self.SetSkinName
        if oldfn then
            function self.SetSkinName(s,skinname,...)
                local old = s.skin_name
                local new = skinname
                if characterskins[old] and characterskins[old].clear_fn then
                    characterskins[old].clear_fn(s.inst,old)
                end
                if characterskins[new] and characterskins[new].init_fn then
                    characterskins[new].init_fn(s.inst,new)
                end
                oldfn(s,skinname,...)
            end
        end
